special2.description: The Runestone Shop sells 13 kinds of Rune Stones, but you can buy only once per day. When the visiting hero brings at least 4 kinds of H7 Fortress creatures, it also sells 3 H7 Rune Stones.

configuration#override.onSelectMessage:
{Runestone Shop}

{Basic Rune Stone}: costs 3 Wood
{Advanced Rune Stone}: costs 3 Wood, 3 Ore
{Expert Rune Stone}: costs 3 Crystal, 3 Gems
{H7 Rune Stone} (Fortune, Destruction, Resilience): costs 3 Crystal, 3 Gems,
sold only if the visiting hero's army has at least 4 kinds of H7 Fortress creatures (basic and upgraded count as one)
Only one can be made per day. Do you want to buy one?

{Runestone Shop}

The rune masters are pleased by your visit, but hearing that you have not brought enough resources, they refuse to make you a Rune Stone.
